scripts.dev: concurrently "pnpm dev:ui" "AGENT_PORT=8100 SEARCH_INDEXER=off MEMORY_LEARN=off MIGRATIONS=off pnpm dev:agent" "pnpm dev:api" --names ui,agent,api --prefix-colors blue,green,magenta --kill-others
scripts.dev:python: AGENT_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9300 concurrently "pnpm dev:ui" "AGENT_PORT=8100 SEARCH_INDEXER=off MEMORY_LEARN=off MIGRATIONS=off pnpm dev:agent" "pnpm dev:api" "pnpm dev:agent-py" --names ui,agent,api,agent-py --prefix-colors blue,green,magenta,yellow --kill-others
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && pnpm -C apps/web typecheck && pnpm -C apps/agent typecheck && pnpm -C packages/contracts typecheck
scripts.test:unit: playwright test --config playwright.unit.config.ts && pnpm -C apps/agent test:unit
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:unit
